R-410A.name: R-410A (Puron)
R-410A.status: Being phased down under AIM Act. Available but decreasing production from 2025+.
R-410A.oilType: POE (Polyolester) - hygroscopic, absorbs moisture quickly. Keep sealed.
R-410A.chargingMethod: Must charge as liquid (blend - vapor charging changes composition).
serviceNotes: Always charge as liquid from tank - invert tank or use liquid port
Do NOT top off charge without finding leak first
POE oil absorbs moisture rapidly - minimize system open time
Requires 500 micron vacuum minimum - lower is better
Higher pressures than R-22 - use 800 psig rated hoses and gauges
replacements: R-32 (direct replacement in new equipment only)
R-454B (Opteon XL41 - approved drop-in for some equipment)

R-22.name: R-22 (HCFC-22, Freon)
R-22.status: BANNED from production/import since Jan 1, 2020. Only reclaimed/recycled available. Price has stabilized but remains high.
R-22.chargingMethod: Can charge as vapor or liquid.
serviceNotes: NO new R-22 production - use reclaimed only
Never mix R-22 with R-410A or other refrigerants
If system needs major repair, recommend R-410A system replacement (better long-term)
Drop-in replacements available (R-407C, R-422D, MO99) but have performance trade-offs
If converting to drop-in: change filter drier, check TXV compatibility, may need oil change

dropInReplacements.R-407C: Closest performance match. Requires POE oil change. TXV adjustment may be needed.
dropInReplacements.MO99 (R-438A): Can work with existing mineral oil in some cases. Check manufacturer approval.
dropInReplacements.R-422D: Easy retrofit but lower efficiency. Works with mineral oil.

R-32.name: R-32 (Difluoromethane)
R-32.status: The future standard. Used in Daikin Fit and many new mini-splits. Replacing R-410A globally.
R-32.chargingMethod: Single component - can charge as liquid or vapor.
serviceNotes: A2L classification - mildly flammable. No open flames during service.
Requires R-32 rated recovery machine and gauges
Electronic leak detectors must be rated for A2L
Same pressure range as R-410A - familiar working pressures
Higher efficiency than R-410A - 10% better COP
Lower charge weight than R-410A for same capacity
Single component - no composition shift, can top off charge (unlike R-410A)
safetyNotes: Burning velocity: 6.7 cm/s (very slow - won't explode but can ignite)
Do not use in enclosed spaces without ventilation
No brazing with refrigerant in system - standard practice applies
A2L rated equipment has safety features: leak sensors, charge limits per room volume

R-454B.name: R-454B (Opteon XL41)
R-454B.status: Approved as R-410A replacement. Carrier, Trane, Lennox developing R-454B equipment for 2025+ installations.
serviceNotes: Designed as near drop-in for R-410A equipment (NOT a retrofit for existing units)
New equipment factory-designed for R-454B
A2L safety requirements same as R-32
Must charge as liquid (blend)
Requires A2L rated tools and recovery equipment
